title: Infant feeding practices by age
subtitle: Percent distribution of youngest children age 0-5 months living with their mother by feeding category, according to age, Kenya Mini DHS 2025-26

footnotes.note: Notes: Breastfeeding status refers to a '24-hour' period (yesterday during the day or night). The categories of breastmilk only; breast milk and plain water only; breast milk and non-milk liquids; breastmilk and formula and/or animal milk; breastmilk and solid, semi-solid, or soft foods; and not breastfed are hierarchical and mutually exclusive. Thus, children who receive breastmilk and non-milk liquids; who do not receive breastmilk and formula and/or animal milk; and who do not receive any solid, semi-solid, or soft foods are classified in the non-milk liquids category even though they may also receive plain water. When combined with the percentages of children whose feeding category is classified as unknown due to 'don't know' responses, the percentages in each row add to 100%. 1 Children fed breast milk plus non-milk liquids (e.g., juice, herbal tea, sweetened water, flavoured water). Children in this category may have also been fed plain water. 2 Includes children fed breast milk plus animal milk, breast milk plus infant formula, or breast milk plus animal milk-based yogurt drinks. Children in this category may have also been fed non-milk liquids and/or plain water. 3 Children fed breast milk plus solid, semi-solid, or soft foods from any food group (e.g., grains, meat, eggs, fruits, vegetables). Children in this category may have also been fed plain water; non-milk liquids; and/or animal milk, infant formula, or animal milk-based yogurt drinks. 4 Not classified elsewhere due to 'don't know' responses
